cues.text: Go further with ShipCheck for release checks, Scout for repository context, and Dispatch for workflows. Installed tools share one Hermes integration.

cues.text: Keep your agent workflow. Add repeatable checks, clear permissions, and evidence for the next developer. That is accountability inside Hermes.
